question: What characterizes the arisen Eye-illumination as filled with supreme nondual nectar?
premises: The Eye-illumination is identified as this work
It is full of the nectar of supreme nonduality
inference: This arisen Eye-illumination is characterized by fullness in the nectar of supreme nonduality.
plain_english: This Netrodyota has arisen, swollen with the nectar of supreme nonduality.
